newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDIENOS TO ALLOW SHARE CONVERSION TO GDRS.
newsitem.headline: MEDIENOS TO ALLOW SHARE CONVERSION TO GDRS.

text.p: Lithuanian cardboard maket Medienos Plaushas said on Thursday that it will allow shareholders to convert 30 percent or more of their shares into global depository receipts.

Chairman of the supervisory council of the company Alfonsas Rimkus said that the Bank of New York would be the depository bank for the securities and that terms will be agreed at a second meeting on June 12 or June 13.
Rimkus made the comments at a presentation about the company and its plans at the stock exchange.
The idea of converting the shares is to provide more liquidity for the shares of the company, he said.
The firm is one of three corporates on the official list of the stock exchange.
